wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap building way 271791487 gives 23 distinct perimeter controls. The full building belongs to the named memorial hall enclosure, way 271791474 (Q10123616). Its narrow central join identifies the break between original villa and connected rear museum extension.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the hipped villa, carriage porch, gallery and rear extension. Near levels show the louvres, railings and porch trim.
limitations: The model shows the conserved exterior familiar from the 2011 reopening through the September 2024 closure. Scaffolding, temporary works and any changes made in the conservation project are omitted.

The published measured building outline controls the plan. Floor, ridge and window heights, rear extension articulation and iron and plaster ornament are estimates. Interiors, statues and garden structures are outside the scope.
